fieldValues.title: A closed blocker leaves its dependent labelled blocked, so the chain waits for a person to notice
fieldValues.summary: When srs-rust#1473 closed on 2026-10-28, srs-programme#189 kept its blocked label; clerk flow showed it held until the driver removed the label by hand. Nothing clears a blocked label when the last blocker closes.
evidence: clerk flow --chain srs-programme#189 (held: blocked) until the label was removed
srs-context#112, 2026-10-30: the blocked label added while #111 was open stayed after #111 closed; clerk claim refused (held: blocked) until the driver removed it by hand
fieldValues.body:
- In an unattended chain, this is a silent stop between every pair of links.
- Recorded under the proposed flow-stop rule fbba3d5e.
